# metacleaner

### Automated curation of DNA barcode reference databases for metabarcoding and metagenomics

DNA barcode reference databases built from NCBI GenBank (for example
with [MetaCurator](https://github.com/RTRichar/MetaCurator)) contain
mislabeled sequences. In pollen metabarcoding with plant ITS1/ITS2
databases, this produces reads assigned to fungi, to the wrong plant
genus, or to several genera at the same identity.

metacleaner checks each sequence in your database. It removes the
sequence if it

1.  matches a database of unwanted sequences (e.g. fungal ITS),
2.  has no match in a database of wanted sequences (e.g. plant ITS), or
3.  matches wanted sequences whose taxonomy disagrees with its own at
    the rank you choose (genus by default).

Everything runs inside R. The sequence search is built in (C++,
multithreaded), so you do not need to install BLAST, Python or
command-line tools.

## Installation

Install from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("metacleaner", dependencies = TRUE)
```

If R reports that package ‘metacleaner’ is not available, it is still
under review at CRAN. Install it from GitHub instead:

``` r

install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("sbresnahan/metacleaner", dependencies = TRUE)
```

Installing from GitHub compiles the package on your computer, so it
needs build tools:
[Rtools](https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/Rtools/) on Windows, or
the Xcode command line tools on macOS (run `xcode-select --install` in
Terminal). Most Linux systems already have them.

## Quick start

``` r

library(metacleaner)

result <- clean_reference(
  query        = "ITS2_database.fasta",   # the database to clean
  reference    = "ITS_plants.fasta",      # sequences you want to keep (e.g. plants)
  contaminants = "ITS_nonplants.fasta",   # sequences you want to remove (e.g. fungi)
  taxonomy     = "ITS2_database.tax",     # or "ncbi" to look taxonomy up online
  level        = "genus",
  threads      = "auto"
)
result                                    # summary
write_results(result, outdir = "cleaned") # cleaned FASTA + taxonomy + report
```

To try it on the example data shipped with the package:

``` r

ex <- function(f) system.file("extdata", f, package = "metacleaner")
clean_reference(ex("query.fasta"), ex("reference.fasta"), ex("contaminants.fasta"),
                taxonomy = ex("taxonomy.tax"))
```

To build the reference and contaminant databases from NCBI:

``` r

build_reference_db('((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) AND Embryophyta[Organism]',
                   "ITS_plants.fasta")
build_reference_db('((((ITS1) OR 5.8S) OR 28S) OR ITS2) NOT Embryophyta[Organism]',
                   "ITS_nonplants.fasta", dereplicate = TRUE)
```

## Documentation

Full documentation, including all help pages and guides, is on the
package website: <https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/>.

- [`vignette("metacleaner")`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/articles/metacleaner.md):
  step-by-step guide, explanation of the settings and outputs, and how
  the old command-line options map onto the R arguments.
- [`vignette("building-databases")`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/articles/building-databases.md):
  downloading reference and contaminant databases from NCBI.
- [`?clean_reference`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/clean_reference.md),
  [`?classify_queries`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/classify_queries.md)
  (exact decision rules) and
  [`?search_sequences`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/search_sequences.md)
  (search engine details).

## Output

| File | Contents |
|----|----|
| `<prefix>_clean.fasta` | kept sequences |
| `<prefix>_clean.tax` | their taxonomy (`taxid,accession,taxid,domain,...,species`; or QIIME-style with `tax_format = "lineage"`) |
| `<prefix>_flagged.tsv` | removed sequences: query taxonomy, the hit that caused removal, its taxonomy, and the reason |
| `<prefix>_summary.txt` | settings and counts per reason |

## Citation

If you use metacleaner in your research, please cite:

Crone, M., Boyle, N., Bresnahan, S.T., Biddinger, D., Grozinger, C.M.
(2023). More than mesolectic: Characterizing the nutritional niche of
*Osmia cornifrons*. Ecology and Evolution 13, e10640.
<https://doi.org/10.1002/ece3.10640>

# Package index

## Clean a reference database

The two functions most users need: run the whole workflow, then save the
cleaned FASTA, taxonomy, list of removed sequences and summary.

- [`clean_reference()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/clean_reference.md)
  : Clean a barcode reference database
- [`write_results()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/write_results.md)
  : Save metacleaner results to files

## Build reference and contaminant databases

Download sequences from NCBI GenBank inside R.

- [`build_reference_db()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/build_reference_db.md)
  : Build a reference (or contaminant) database from NCBI
- [`download_ncbi_sequences()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/download_ncbi_sequences.md)
  : Download sequences from NCBI GenBank

## Taxonomy

Read taxonomy from a file, from NCBI web services, or from a local
taxonomizr database.

- [`read_taxonomy()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/read_taxonomy.md)
  : Read a taxonomy file
- [`taxonomy_from_ncbi()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/taxonomy_from_ncbi.md)
  : Look up taxonomy for accessions from NCBI
- [`taxonomy_from_taxonomizr()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/taxonomy_from_taxonomizr.md)
  : Look up taxonomy for accessions in a local taxonomizr database
- [`taxonomic_ranks()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/taxonomic_ranks.md)
  : Taxonomic ranks used by metacleaner

## Individual steps

The search and decision steps that clean_reference() runs, for advanced
use.

- [`search_sequences()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/search_sequences.md)
  : Search query sequences against a database of sequences
- [`classify_queries()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/classify_queries.md)
  : Decide which query sequences to flag
- [`blast_available()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/blast_available.md)
  : Check whether BLAST+ is installed

## Working with FASTA files

- [`read_fasta()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/read_fasta.md)
  : Read sequences from a FASTA file
- [`write_fasta()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/write_fasta.md)
  : Write sequences to a FASTA file
- [`dereplicate()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/dereplicate.md)
  : Remove duplicate sequences
- [`reverse_complement()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/reverse_complement.md)
  : Reverse complement DNA sequences
- [`extract_accession()`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/extract_accession.md)
  : Extract accessions from FASTA header lines

## About the package

- [`metacleaner`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/metacleaner-package.md)
  [`metacleaner-package`](https://seantbresnahan.com/metacleaner/reference/metacleaner-package.md)
  : metacleaner: Automated Curation of DNA Barcode Reference Databases
